name: Wight (BB)

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

items.name: Final Spite
items.text: When the wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points, they can use their reaction to make a Strike before being destroyed. They don't gain any Hit Points from corrupting spite on this Strike.

items.name: Corrupting Spite
items.text: When the wight deals damage to a living creature with their claw or dagger Strike, the wight regains 2 healing Hit Points and the target must succeed at a DC 17 Fortitude save save or take 2 damage that can't be healed. The wight can use corrupting spite multiple times, but a single creature can't take more than 8 unhealable damage. Each full night of rest heals 2 of the unhealable damage, and a full day of bed rest increases the recovery of the unhealable damage to 4.

text: Wights are undead humanoids that lurk in burial grounds, catacombs, or other places of the dead.
